description: A compact, clean, and realistic CT examination room

steps.condition: CT scanner is centered in the room
patient is present and walking around the room

steps.target_area: aligned with the CT scanner bore
steps.condition: table is aligned with the scanner in/out axis

steps.target_area: head of the table, slightly to the right
steps.condition: monitor is at the head of the table, near the control corner
chair is near the monitor/control station on the right side

steps.target_area: near the table on the monitor side
steps.condition: cart is near the table, on the monitor side

steps.target_area: near the head of the table, opposite the monitor
steps.condition: IV drip is near the head of the table, opposite the monitor

steps.target_area: near the chair or by the entry corner
steps.condition: waste bucket is near the chair or by the entry corner
sanitizer is mounted near the entry wall

steps.target_area: high on the wall above or near the monitor
steps.condition: clock is mounted high on the wall above or near the monitor

steps.target_area: near the scanner, slightly in front
steps.condition: caution sign is near the scanner, slightly in front
room has a 6m x 6m enclosure with a doorway and ceiling light fixture
